business.name: Top Feet
business.description: Your local sanctuary for foot reflexology, massage therapy, and holistic wellness. Because you deserve to feel your best.

hero.description: Premium foot reflexology and full-body massage services designed to melt away stress, relieve tension, and restore your natural balance. Your wellness journey starts here.

services.name: Foot Reflexology
services.description: Ancient healing art targeting pressure points on your feet that correspond to organs and systems throughout your body. Deep relief from the ground up.

services.name: Full Body Massage
services.description: A head-to-toe therapeutic experience that targets muscle tension, improves circulation, and leaves you in a state of complete relaxation and renewal.

services.name: Hot Stone Therapy
services.description: Smooth, heated volcanic stones placed at key points on the body. The warmth penetrates deep into muscle tissue, releasing chronic tension and stress.

services.name: Deep Tissue Massage
services.description: Firm, targeted pressure to reach the deeper layers of muscle and fascia. Ideal for chronic pain, sports recovery, and stubborn tension knots.

services.name: Aromatherapy
services.description: Combining the power of essential oils with gentle massage techniques to balance your mind, body, and spirit. Calming, energizing, or uplifting blends.

services.name: Couples Retreat
services.description: Share the gift of relaxation side-by-side. Our couples suite offers a private, intimate setting for two to experience synchronized massage and total tranquility.

experience.description: We believe true wellness starts the moment you walk through our doors. Every detail of your visit is designed to help you feel better — not just during your session, but long after.

features.title: Certified Expert Therapists
features.description: All therapists are licensed, trained, and continuously educated in the latest techniques.

features.title: Premium Products Only
features.description: We use top-grade organic oils, lotions, and aromatherapy blends for your skin and senses.

features.title: Calming, Private Environment
features.description: Our spa rooms are designed as personal sanctuaries — quiet, warm, and completely private.

testimonials.name: Sarah M.
testimonials.text: I've been to many spas over the years, but Top Feet is on another level. The foot reflexology session completely transformed my chronic back pain. I walked in hunched and walked out standing straight. Absolutely incredible.

testimonials.name: Jennifer L.
testimonials.text: My husband and I did the couples retreat for our anniversary — best decision we ever made. The staff was professional, the room was stunning, and the massage was deeply relaxing. We've already booked our next visit.

testimonials.name: Marcus R.
testimonials.text: As an athlete, recovery is everything. The deep tissue sessions at Top Feet have become a non-negotiable part of my training. The therapists actually understand anatomy and target exactly what needs work.
